outputs.explanation: Panel A is a 3D segmented rendering of a tomogram (schematic-style visualization of pre-conoidal rings and actin filament), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B is a 3D segmented rendering of the basal end of a sporozoite, not a plot.
Panel C is a tomogram slice (micrograph) showing thin pellicular filaments, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D is a 3D segmented/schematic rendering of a lateral section of the cell, not a plot.
Panel E is a slice through an averaged tomogram volume shown as a micrograph image, not a plot with quantified averages/error bars.
Panel F is a tomogram slice (micrograph) showing a pellicular actin filament connected to a TPF, not a plot of averaged data.
